title: Liquid Reese Decay
description: A detuned sawtooth reese bass in the mid register, sculpted by a resonant ladder filter envelope and a slow seasick vibrato for liquid character. Over a 32-cycle pass the ladder cutoff opens and closes while crush and coarse degradation creep in and recede, so the tone slowly corrodes into alien grit and then heals.
code:
setcpm(110/4)
stack(
  note("<f2 f2 ab2 [eb2 c2]>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .detune(sine.slow(13).range(0.12, 0.4))
    .off(0.005, x => x.add(note(-0.15)).gain(0.5))
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(17).range(0.15, 1.1))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(220, 2600)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(24).range(1.5, 4)).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.22).lpsustain(0.4)
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 5))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4 2 1>/3")
    .shape(0.28)
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.25).sustain(0.6).release(0.12)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .room(0.3).delay("0.4:0.5:0.6")
    .gain(0.85)
)
